resources.string: Connect on allowed networks; pause on excluded Wi-Fi. Manual disconnect lasts until the next network change. Turning this off leaves the current connection unchanged.
One exact, case-sensitive Wi-Fi name per line, up to 32 UTF-8 bytes. If the name cannot be read, the VPN stays paused.
Only needed for Wi-Fi exclusions: grant precise location, then choose Allow all the time in system settings and enable device location. Tap to authorize or open settings.
Location permission granted. Keep device location enabled to read Wi-Fi names.
Automatic connection enabled on this network
Paused on this network; monitoring changes
Paused: cannot read Wi-Fi name. Check location permission.
Select a downloaded profile and grant VPN permission first.
Applies to profiles inheriting the global script, before settings overrides. Errors stop connection.

Define main(config) and return a configuration object. Preview does not change the connection. No file, network or timer access; execution limit 2 seconds. UI settings and Android TUN fields take priority.
